_what: Stage 02. Drawn-bond geometry for the three purified structures, from the PDF's own filled bond outlines.

structures.label: 1C12-D
structures.glyph_separation_mode: NONE REQUIRED -- measured, not assumed: all glyphs on these pages are bitmap images, not paths, so filled mode returns bond outlines only. The exact 2:1 segments-per-bond ratio is the evidence.
structures.why_stroked_is_zero: the bonds are FILLED outlines, not strokes; curation/lib/chains reads strokes and correctly declines to report a number here
structures.degree_note: the drawn degree sequence is DESCRIPTIVE, not asserted: bonds stop short of the 'N' and 'H' glyphs (which are images, not text), so endpoints at a heteroatom do not merge cleanly and that atom is split into separate vertices. The BOND COUNT is the assertion; the degree sequence is reported so a reviewer sees exactly how far the topology was actually checked.
